title: Custom frontmatter (extension seam)
$comment: promptless.ai-specific frontmatter rules that no schema listed before this one in manni.config.yaml covers, so manni.config.yaml never needs to change for them. manni:core:1.0.0 already requires `title` and `description` and sets the form of `id`; tgdp:templates:1.1 and its strict overlay own `type`. This schema adds two rules. It requires `id`, which manni:core:1.0.0 defines but doesn't require, because docs.metadata.yaml joins each page's maintainer metadata on it. It keeps a format check on `tags`, which no manni vocabulary defines. To add another repo-specific rule, add the field to "required" or describe it under "properties". If you extend Astro's zod schema in src/content.config.ts (docsSchema({ extend })), mirror the same fields here so violations fail in CI, not at build time.

id.description: Stable page identifier: the page's slug without the leading `docs/`, with `/` replaced by `-` (for example `for-docs-audit-doc-detective`). Keep it when the page moves, because docs.metadata.yaml and other pages' `prerequisites`, `next-steps`, and `related-pages` reference it.

tags.description: Short strings for categorization: the page's section and type.
